主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced a reset dividend rate on its Series 26 and Series 25 Preference Shares. The announcement was made as part of a Form 6-K filing with the SEC on March 3, 2017. The filing includes Exhibit 99.1, which details the dividend rate adjustment. The company is a financial services firm based in Canada, with its principal executive offices in Toronto. The change in dividend rate reflects a decision by the company to adjust its distribution policy for these preference shares. The filing does not provide further details on the reasons for the change or the new dividend rate. The information is intended for regulatory purposes and does not include market impact analysis or predictions.
